pages.title: Analytic Continuator
pages.text: Calculus in a box: limits, derivatives, integrals, series and the analytic continuation of functions into the complex plane.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
Analytic continuation is the strangest of these: a function known on a small patch extends in exactly one way across the complex plane. That is how zeta gets a value where its series diverges.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Complex Plane, Derivative Operator, Differential Manifold, Eigenstate Lattice, Fourier Series, Fractal Core, Fractal Lattice Block, Fractal Set, Function Graph, Hamiltonian Operator, Infinitesimal, Integral Operator, Koch Crystal, Modular Form...
